name: Multi-Mode Rendering with Iso-surfaces and Meshes
aliases: Hybrid Ray Tracing for Iso-surfaces and Meshes
definition: A rendering mode supporting volume data, implicit iso-surfaces, and triangle meshes, using separate BVHs and hardware-accelerated intersection tests.
summary: Multi-Mode Rendering with Iso-surfaces and Meshes is a hybrid technique combining hardware-accelerated ray-triangle intersection for meshes and volume ray marching for isosurfaces, distinguished by its two-stage surface hit detection and separate BVHs for efficient empty space skipping.
